'''Benny Sudakov''' ([[Hebrew language|Hebrew]]: בני סודקוב; born October 1969)<ref name="notices"/> is an Israeli mathematician, who works mainly on [[Extremal combinatorics|extremal]] and [[probabilistic combinatorics]].

== Biography ==
Sudakov was born in [[Tbilissi|Tbilisi]], Georgia,<ref name="notices">{{citation|url=http://www.ams.org/notices/201208/rtx120801134p.pdf|journal=[[Notices of the American Mathematical Society]]|title=Biographies of Candidates 2012|year=2012|volume=59|issue=8|page=1140}}</ref> and completed his undergraduate studies at [[Tbilisi State University]] in 1990.<ref name="CV"/> After emigrating to Israel, he received his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] from [[Tel Aviv University]] in 1999, under the supervision of [[Noga Alon]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=60733}}</ref>
From 1999 until 2002, he held a [[Veblen Research Instructorship]],<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.ias.edu/scholars/benjamin-sudakov|title = IAS scholar information site| date=9 December 2019 }}</ref> a joint position between [[Princeton University]] and the [[Institute for Advanced Study]]. Until 2007, he was an assistant professor at Princeton University. Until 2014, he was a professor at the [[University of California, Los Angeles]].<ref name="CV">{{cite web |url=http://www.math.ethz.ch/~sudakovb/beny.pdf |title=Benny Sudakov's CV}}</ref> In July 2013, Sudakov joined [[ETH Zurich]] as a professor.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.math.ethz.ch/news_events/index |title=ETH Zurich appoints Benjamin Sudakov |author=Department of Mathematics |website=www.math.ethz.ch|date=September 27, 2012 |accessdate=February 6, 2013}}</ref>

Sudakov has broad interests within the field of [[combinatorics]], having written papers on [[extremal combinatorics]], [[Ramsey theory]], [[random graph]]s, and [[positional game]]s.<ref name="CV" />

In 2012, he became a Fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180825194636/http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list |date=2018-08-25 }}, retrieved 2013-08-05.</ref> He gave an [[list of International Congresses of Mathematicians Plenary and Invited Speakers|invited talk]] at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in 2010 at [[Hyderabad]], on the topic of "Combinatorics".<ref>{{cite web|title=ICM Plenary and Invited Speakers since 1897|url=http://www.mathunion.org/db/ICM/Speakers/SortedByCongress.php|publisher=[[International Congress of Mathematicians]]|access-date=2013-08-15|archive-date=2017-11-08|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171108012153/http://www.mathunion.org/db/ICM/Speakers/SortedByCongress.php|url-status=dead}}</ref>
